About MedTech For Solutions

The ART Industry's Most Trusted Partner

MedTech For Solutions, founded in 2005, is a healthcare company specializing in the assisted reproductive technology (ART) industry. Based in White Plains, NY, we deliver comprehensive solutions for fertility clinics, IVF labs, and reproductive medicine centers across the U.S. and internationally.

Our team of laboratory, clinical, risk management, revenue cycle management, and marketing specialists brings practical experience in ART and practice management. We offer hands-on implementation and management support that enhances your competitive edge, drives laboratory success, and boosts your profitability.

In addition, MedTech provides a Group Purchasing Organization (GPO) tailored for the fertility sector. Through our vendor partnerships and national purchasing network, practices enjoy preferred pricing and volume discounts on essential products and services.

By leveraging our collective buying power, MedTech helps ART practices of all sizes reduce operational costs and access advanced technologies, ultimately improving financial outcomes without sacrificing patient care.

Solutions for Reproductive Healthcare

One Partner for the Laboratory and the Business of ART

MedTech For Solutions supports fertility programs across the full lifecycle of a practice. On the laboratory side, that means ART laboratory design and construction, FDA, CLIA, CAP, and AABB regulatory readiness, and temporary staffing with experienced, TS (ABB) certified embryologists and HCLD off-site laboratory directors supporting fertility clinics nationwide.

On the business side, our Group Purchasing Organization pools the collective buying power of member practices through an established network of vendor partners — free to join, with no purchasing obligations — while our management services cover marketing, call center operations, accounting and finance, human resources, and professional liability and risk management.

Founded in 2005 and headquartered in White Plains, NY, MedTech pairs hands-on implementation with practical ART industry experience, so practices of every size can reduce operating costs, stay inspection-ready, and grow with confidence.

FAQ

Common Questions About MedTech For Solutions

MedTech For Solutions is a healthcare consulting company founded in 2005, specializing exclusively in the assisted reproductive technology (ART) industry. Based in White Plains, NY, MedTech provides IVF laboratory management, practice development, temporary staffing, recruitment, regulatory compliance, and group purchasing services to fertility clinics and IVF laboratories across the United States and internationally.

MedTech provides comprehensive IVF laboratory services including laboratory design and construction, real-time monitoring via the OvaTools platform, regulatory compliance for FDA, CLIA, CAP, and AABB, quality control programs, temporary staffing with TS (ABB) certified professionals, group purchasing through an established network of vendor partners, and practice development consulting — all focused exclusively on ART laboratories nationwide.

MedTech's GPO is designed exclusively for fertility practices. By pooling the collective buying power of member practices, the GPO helps secure preferred pricing across laboratory supplies, clinical products, and operational services.

The GPO is free to join with no purchasing obligations or spending commitments, and members benefit from an established network of vendor partners including leaders in laboratory and office supply categories. GPO members also receive meaningful cost savings on MedTech professional services.

Participation in MedTech's GPO means your practice benefits from the negotiating leverage of an entire network of fertility clinics — reducing costs on everything from everyday office supplies and shipping to specialized laboratory reagents and equipment, freeing resources to reinvest in patient care and practice growth.

Yes. MedTech provides short-term laboratory staffing to meet the immediate coverage needs of fertility clinics and IVF laboratories. Available roles include embryologists and HCLD off-site directors, all TS (ABB) certified and ready to integrate seamlessly into your laboratory operations.

Beyond laboratory solutions, MedTech provides five management services: data-driven marketing, dedicated call center operations, accounting and financial oversight, human resources, and professional liability insurance and risk management.

MedTech For Solutions is headquartered at 399 Knollwood Road, White Plains, NY 10603. They serve fertility clinics nationwide and internationally. Contact: (866) 634-9144 or info@medtech4solutions.com.
